known.article: North Fork of Long Island AVA
known.via: English Wikipedia "North Fork of Long Island AVA"

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

blurb.text: A Long Island AVA on a peninsula, with a maritime climate moderated by the Sound, Peconic Bay and the Atlantic. This lengthens the growing season by up to a month. Merlot, Chardonnay and Cabernet Franc are the most planted grapes.
